newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine May industrial output up 5.2 pct-FIEL.
newsitem.headline: Argentine May industrial output up 5.2 pct-FIEL.

text.p: Argentine industrial output was up 5.2 percent in May compared to the same month last year, according to preliminary figures Wednesday announced by the FIEL economic cunsultancy.
Output in the month was 2.6 percent higher than in April this year, FIEL said.
May's figures compared to growth of 8.1 percent in April from the same month a year ago, according to FIEL.
"The big contraction in demand in the non-durable goods sector compared to April explains a large part of the fall in the indicator," FIEL said in a press release.

Industrial stocks fell compared with April, but stayed within normal levels. Utilization of installed capcity was 75.7 percent, 0.3 points higher than in May last year and 0.9 points higher than this April, FIEL said.
"The prospects for the next few months are still optimistic," it said.
FIEL said that 12 percent of firms it surveyed expected the economy to improve in the short term, while 86 percent expected no variation.
